extraction_notes: Pacific Life "Workforce Benefits Proposal" multi-product document. Table of contents on page 3 lists all products with page numbers (Dental, Vision, Basic Life/AD&D, Voluntary Life/AD&D, STD, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident). For the Voluntary Term Life and AD&D product (titled "Group Voluntary Term Life Insurance and AD&D" / "Group Voluntary Term Life and AD&D Insurance"), the rate summary table appears on its own page (here page 15) titled "Rate Summary" with a single combined table listing age bands in far-left column ("Life Coverage") and two columns: "Employee Life Rates" and "Spouse Life Rates" - in this document these two columns were IDENTICAL at every age band, but still extract both columns separately as they are headed independently. 13 age bands total: <25, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80+. Rates are per $1,000 of coverage, monthly. Below the main age-banded table are two small flat-rate tables: "Child Life Coverage" (single flat rate per $1,000, labeled 'Up to age 26') and "AD&D" (three flat rows: Employee, Spouse, Child - each a flat rate per $1,000 of Life Insurance, NOT age-banded). Plan design details (benefit increments, guaranteed issue, max benefit, employee contribution %, age reduction schedule) are on subsequent pages per class: Employee class on page 16 ("Voluntary Life Plan - Employee Coverage": increments of $10,000, GI $80,000, max benefit <5X or $250,000, min 45% participation), Spouse class on page 17 ("Voluntary Life and AD&D Plan - Spouse Coverage": increments of $5,000, GI $20,000, max $100,000, limited to 50% of employee amount), Child class on page 18 ("Voluntary Life and AD&D Plan - Child Coverage": flat $10,000 benefit, live birth to age 26). AD&D plan features (seat belt, air bag, child care/tuition, home alteration, additional features list) appear on page 17 under "Voluntary AD&D Plan - Employee Coverage" - these are feature riders, not separate rate classes. Total coverage classes to extract for this product: Employee (age-banded, life), Spouse (age-banded, life), Child (flat, life), plus AD&D flat rates for Employee/Spouse/Child (3 more flat entries) = 6 total class entries. Document also contains Basic (non-voluntary) Term Life and AD&D as a SEPARATE flat-rate product (not age-banded, $20,000 flat benefit) - do not confuse with the Voluntary product. Other non-life products (Dental, Vision, STD, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident) appear elsewhere in document with their own distinct rate table formats (e.g., Critical Illness uses attained-age bands with 4 relationship-tier columns; STD uses age-banded per-$10-of-weekly-benefit rates) - ignore these if only extracting Voluntary Life/AD&D.
